extDescription.message: Auto-claims free Steam games in the background using your existing browser session. No password, no cookie access, no server.

notifyLoginBody.message: Log in to the Steam store in this browser so FreeKeep can claim: $NAMES$

notifyExpiredRenewBody.message: Click here to renew it. FreeKeep then claims: $NAMES$

notifyExpiredOpenBody.message: Click here to open the Steam store, which renews it. FreeKeep then claims: $NAMES$

notifyFailedBody.message: $NAMES$ — open FreeKeep to retry or claim it on the store page.

popupLoggedOut.message: Log in to the Steam store in this browser so FreeKeep can claim games.

popupExpiredTab.message: Steam's web login lasts 24 hours. Renewing loads the Steam store in a background tab for a moment.

popupExpiredRemind.message: Steam's web login lasts 24 hours. Opening the Steam store renews it.

popupExpiredNoPermission.message: Automatic renewal isn't allowed yet. Renew with one click, or allow it in settings.

popupEmptyBody.message: FreeKeep checks every $HOURS$ h and claims new free-to-keep games for you.

popupNoAccessTitle.message: No access to the Steam store

popupNoAccessBody.message: FreeKeep's access to store.steampowered.com was turned off in the browser's extension settings, so it can't check or claim games.

optIntervalHint.message: A check also runs shortly after the browser starts.

optMode.message: When a free game is found

optModeHint.message: “Ask me first” never claims on its own. Claiming only adds the license to your Steam account; nothing is downloaded or installed.

optRenewHint.message: Steam's web login lasts 24 hours and renews whenever you open a Steam page. FreeKeep's background checks don't renew it.

optRenewTabHint.message: You get a notification. One click loads the Steam store in a background tab that closes when done. No extra permission.

optRenewAutoHint.message: FreeKeep opens Steam's renewal address in the background, as visiting a Steam page does. Needs access to login.steampowered.com. The login is exchanged between your browser and Steam; FreeKeep never sees it.

optRenewRemindHint.message: You only get a notification; FreeKeep never opens a tab on its own. Clicking the notification opens the Steam store.

optRenewDenied.message: Permission not granted. Your previous choice is kept.

optRenewMissing.message: The permission for automatic renewal was removed, so you'll get the one-click option instead.

optDlc.message: Also claim DLC for games I own

optPrivacy.message: FreeKeep only talks to store.steampowered.com, using this browser's existing Steam login (plus login.steampowered.com if you turn on automatic renewal, Epic's public list of free games if you turn on Epic reminders, and GOG's public home page and catalog if you turn on GOG reminders). It never sees your password and never sends your data anywhere.

optAbout.message: Not affiliated with Valve. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.

popupPrivacy.message: 100% local · can't see your password or login cookie

notifyEpicTitle.message: Free on the Epic Games Store

notifyEpicBody.message: $NAMES$ — free until $DATE$. Click to open the store.

notifyGogBody.message: $NAMES$ — free until $DATE$. Click to open GOG.

notifyGogBodyOpen.message: $NAMES$ — free on GOG now. Click to open GOG.

epicReminderOnly.message: Reminder only · claim it on Epic's site

epicNoPermission.message: Allow FreeKeep to read Epic's public list of free games.

epicError.message: Couldn't load Epic's list. FreeKeep will retry on the next check.

epicNone.message: Nothing free on Epic right now.

gogReminderOnly.message: Reminder only · claim it on GOG's site

gogHowGiveaway.message: Claim it on GOG's home page

gogHowDeal.message: Add to cart, check out for free

gogNoPermission.message: Allow FreeKeep to read GOG's public home page and catalog.

gogError.message: Couldn't load GOG's list. FreeKeep will retry on the next check.

gogNone.message: Nothing free on GOG right now.

optEpic.message: Remind me of free games on the Epic Games Store

optEpicHint.message: Optional. Epic games can't be claimed automatically, so FreeKeep tells you what's free and opens the store page. Turning this on asks for permission to read Epic's public list of free games; no Epic account or login is used.

optEpicDenied.message: Permission wasn't granted, so Epic reminders stay off.

optGog.message: Remind me of free games on GOG

optGogHint.message: Optional. Covers giveaways on GOG's home page and games discounted to 0, which you get by checking out for free. Turning this on asks for permission to read GOG's public home page and catalog; no GOG account or login is used.

optGogDenied.message: Permission wasn't granted, so GOG reminders stay off.

optRemindersHint.message: Epic and GOG games can't be claimed automatically: claiming there needs your own login, which FreeKeep never touches. FreeKeep tells you what's free and opens the right page.

optAutoSave.message: Everything is on this one page. Changes save automatically.

optModeAutoHint.message: Adds it to your library as soon as it's found, then tells you.

optModeAskHint.message: Only notifies you; you decide in the popup.

optNotificationsHint.message: Only when a game is claimed, a claim fails, or something needs you.

optLinksHint.message: Read live from the permissions your browser has given FreeKeep.

hostStore.message: Find promotions, check your library, claim

optChestHint.message: Pick a preset or your own body and lock colours. Highlights, shadows and the sparkle are matched automatically.
